description: This Java class provides custom assertion methods for verifying Bson objects and collections of Bson objects, extending the AssertJ Assertions class for testing purposes.

classes.name: BsonAssertions
classes.description: Assertion utility class for Bson objects, extending AssertJ's Assertions class, providing custom assertion methods for Bson and collections of Bson.

methods.name: assertThat (Bson)
methods.description: Creates a BsonAssert for a single Bson object.

methods.name: assertThat (Collection<Bson>)
methods.description: Creates a BsonCollectionAssert for a collection of Bson objects.
